item.title: Surface Tension of Software
item.description:
📝 That invisible resistance, surface tension, keeps the liquid whole even when disturbed. Constraint-driven design makes that gravity visible. Consider a UI that fetches user data.
🔗 Read more: https://iamstelios.com/blog/surface-tension-of-software/

item.title: “You should never build a CMS”
item.description:
📝 The content === page trapWhat happens when your pricing lives in three places. You can't grep for "content that references this product entity" because markdown doesn't have entities. Structured content breaks the content = page assumption on purpose.
🔗 Read more: https://www.sanity.io/blog/you-should-never-build-a-cms
